content: Sauga o elana Pilistiya wali tolohaveyan hi pamigogoil panuwa Apek elana nihi na nihi haveyan Isileli elal. Kin Akis i baek Deibid elana i ba, “Nu atena bubun alomwau ge wam hevalau nuku tubwi eliyau, yaka alomeyau komiu ta haveyan Isileli elal.”

Inoke Deibid i baek elana i ba, “Ebo i ola, he totom abwe nu kite nau wam totuwalali ga na lohaveyan ola.” Inoke Akis i baek elana i ba, “Ebo i ola, he na telewa nu tabwa o tomatahikan sauga gegewena.”
Sol I Na Yova Tolosevasevan elana
He valila Samuwela i aliga, yaka Isileli gegewel hi kahikahin kaiwena, inoke abwe tuwana hi teliya wana panuwaa Lama. I ola al, Sol iyaka tolosevasevan ge tokukula i paveyahol Isileli gamwanaa.

Pilistiya wali tolohaveyan hi pamigogoil i mowasi, yaka hi tukik hi na Isileli wali labiya hi holaviya panuwa Sunem. Yaa Isileli wali tolohaveyan gegewel Sol i pamigogoil, yaka hi na hi holaviya oya Gilbowa.
Sauga Sol matana i nok Pilistiya wali tolohaveyan i kitel, inoke i lovakun nabi ge atena i bwanabwana.
Yaka i nel Yehoba elana i ba, “Ga na ginol ola?” Yaa wana nel Yehoba nige i lalahe ebo kenonou elana, o ebo pat Ulim ge Tamim elal, o ebo palopitau eliyalil.
Yaka i baek wana totuwalali alaliya bwabwatal elal i ba, “Yova tolosevasevan
etega nuku loyaan, yaka na na na nel eliyana ga na ginol ola.” Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Etega iyoho panuwa Endol.”

Inoke Sol kin ali galogaloi i palo kaliko getoga i galoi, yaka bahi ana awa gamagalau nihi eunaan. Bulina alonau ge wana tolohaveyan labui hi na yova elana, inoke i baek elana i ba, “Toaliga etega toto alana na lumen sevasevanina nu yogaan ge eliyana na pwawa ga na ginol ola.”
Yaa yova i baek elana i ba, “U atena te tolosevasevan ge tokukula Sol i paveyahol Isileli gamwanaa. Ga i ola ge u laboseyau ge o kota u ginol, yaka eliyana nihi lopaaligau?”
Inoke Sol i papasila i ba, “Ya papasila Yehoba yawalina gaganina alanaa, ebo nu ginol ola o, nige lahi etega nu pwapwawa.”
Inoke yova i nel elana i ba, “Henala sevasevanina na yogaan kaiwem?” Anana Sol i lahe i ba, “Samuwela.”
Inoke yova i ginol ola Sol wana baaba. Sauga Samuwela i kite, inoke i loi anana i bwata. Yaka i baek Sol elana i ba, “Hauna kaiwena u kakaweyau? He owa Sol.”
Yaka kin i baek yova elana i ba, “Bahi lovakun. No wasa ga nu pem, hauna gun u kite?” Yova i baek elana i ba, “I ola yabowaine etega ya kite i heem bilibili gamwanaa.”
Yaka Sol i nel i ba, “Ana awa ga i ola?” Anana i lahe i ba, “I ola tonowak lilikena etega holahola yayapona i galoi.” Inoke Sol i atena Samuwela to, yaka i kululu maninina i pahanalowanek bilibiliya.

Samuwela i baek Sol elana i ba, “Hauna kaiwena u yogaagau ya nem inoke no minamina u apanak?” Anana Sol i lahe i ba, “I pulowan hot eliyau, kaiwena Pilistiya hi nem hi haveyan elau, i ola al Yehoba o en i pem. Sauga ebo na nel Yehoba elana, no nel nige i lalahe ebo palopitau eliyalil o ebo kenonou elana. Heiya te kaiwena ya yogaagiwa, yaka no wasa nu pem hauna binimala na ginol.”
Samuwela i baek elana i ba, “Yehoba iyaka am en i pewa, ge i tabwa am topihigelgel, inoke bahi nu nenel elau hauna binimala na ba nu ginol.
Yehoba iyaka i ginol eliyam i ola te valila i baem eliyau ge ya baunaniwa. Yehoba iyaka abalogugui i kukuyoho elam, ge i pek alom etega elana, he Deibid bana.
Lan ebe Yehoba i ginol i ola to eliyam, kaiwena nige wana baaba u hehenapu-an ge wana huga gamagaliliyau Amaleki u aapapanak-agil.
Bwaligumwa owa ge boda Isileli ni telemiu Pilistiya nimaliyaa, yaka alomwau ge natumwau bolau nihi lopaaligamiu inoke alowau komiu ta minaa Tuma.
He Isileli wami tolohaveyan ni telel Pilistiya nimaliyaa ge nihi pakokovel.”
Sol baaba o i hago yaka i lovakun nabi, inoke sauga o elana i sogu i talpo bilibiliya. He tuwana i pweyata, kaiwena lan ge bulin bwabwaligena nige i aanan.
Yova i na Sol elana ge i kite te i lovakun nabi, inoke i baek elana i ba, “Tonowak, nau wam totuwalali yovana, yawaliu ya talamwan yaka ya ginol i ola hauna toto u baunan eliyau.
Inoke no baaba ga nu hago. Aanan enuna na pwatanim nu an ge tuwam ni gasisi yaka abwe nu nawanawa.”

Yaa Sol i towa, yaka i ba, “Nigeya! Nige na aanan.” Inoke wana tolohaveyan bolau labui heliya al avaliya yova hi ba balbalgig te ni anan, yaka abwe wali baaba i hago ge i talam. Inoke i lutem bilibiliya i na i misiyo abamisiyo pwatanaa.

Yova wana bulumwakau natuna tatabwana etega iyoho wana limiya, inoke etimwawa i na i tagapaaliga, yaka bunumwina enuna i liga. Inoke pwalawa i ahe i pitoli ge beleid nige alona yis hi vivikuhiya i umun.
Yaka i na aanan i teli Sol alonau ge wana tolohaveyan labui maniniliyaa ge hi anan. Hi anan haba, yaka bulin maisena o yova hi eguluwan ge hi sikal.

footnotes.text: Tolosevasevan wali siba i gan inoke gamagal toto iyaka i aliga yayaluwana o ebo ta ba sevasevanina nihi yogaan ni nem elal avaliya nihi liwaliwan. Yehoba pagan ya i lopwali. Libai 19:31; 20:27 ge Logugui 18:10-11 nu kite.
Tuma iya toyaomal wali abamina, yaka hi matamatan yatala mowamowasena.
